title: BOM, drift check and sync
routing: Is this about keeping a repo coherent with the inixiative version manifest: versions.json (the BOM: bun, toolchain pins, required, the ecosystem/agentic blessed sets, consumers, candidates, holds) or its @inixiative/config/versions.json export, the drift rules `inixiative-config check` enforces and `sync` repairs (toolchain pins once at the root, peer floors, @inixiative/* ranges, stale bun.lock, required scripts), `scan` across every checkout under a root, the bin's per-command flags (exit 2), the reusable lib-ci.yml workflow, or who bumps what versus Renovate? Jobs: read which version is blessed, pick up new toolchain pins, fix a stale lockfile or a range that misses the blessed version, check every checkout in a folder, set up a lib repo's CI.
